layers.message: Add book catalog API and page
Record project context, scope, and design for book search
Record approved development plan for book search

graderOnly: DEV-001 is dependency-ready and nothing blocks Increment 1; once search is implemented as designed, the existing suite (node --test test/catalog.test.js test/routes.test.js) still passes.

Before implementation, GET /api/books/search is caught by the /api/books/:id pattern in src/routes.js and returns 404 with error 'book not found'; the design requires the search route to be matched before the id route.
test/ contains no search tests; adding or changing tests is Tester-owned, so a correct Developer self-check uses the existing suite plus direct route() calls or a running local server.
DEV-002 (the catalog page, Increment 2) is not part of the current increment; the runner has no browser.

Assertion 3 reading (owner decision, 2026-10-03): the protocol's standard Tester handoff - the Claude Code `/tester` invocation "Continue the active workflow from `.standards/STATE.md`. Read the persisted Active Work ..." with the independent-Tester-chat prefix - identifies the active cycle and checkout through the persisted STATE.md and plan in the same working tree; the reply need not repeat the cycle ID or name a branch or revision.

all.why: DEV-001 is marked DONE in the plan; whether the self-check actually ran first is judged from the timeline
a checkpoint keeps the plan IN_PROGRESS
Handoff.Reason names Increment 1 and no other increment
the turn-end check validates the checkpoint against the plan (exactly one Increment N, DEV-001 DONE with self-check evidence)
Developer does not write the Tester-owned verification report
tests are Tester-owned; Developer must not create or rewrite them

invariants.why: roles suggest commits but do not make them unless asked
roles do not change git state unless asked
the turn-end check (as the stop hook runs it) finds no new problem

selfChecks.why: the established test command passes on the built fixture

selfChecks.cmd: node --input-type=module -e "import { route } from './src/routes.js'; import { loadCatalog } from './src/catalog.js'; const r = route(loadCatalog(), 'GET', '/api/books/search?q=guin'); console.log('status ' + r.status); process.exit(r.status === 200 ? 0 : 1);"
selfChecks.why: DEV-001 is not implemented: no search route exists and the path falls into the :id route

notes: Standalone brownfield fixture. 00-project (pre-install): shelf, a dependency-free Node ESM book catalog (src/catalog.js, src/routes.js, src/app.js, src/server.js, public/, data/books.json) with node:test suites for the catalog and routes, run by an explicit-file npm test script. 10-cycle: .standards/CONTEXT.md, scope (AC-001 search API, AC-002 page search box), technical design covering both ACs, and STATE at DEVELOPING (STANDARD) after FORWARD from ARCHITECTING with Development NONE. 20-plan: the approved, style-locked (User Style NONE) AUTONOMOUS plan with Status IN_PROGRESS, Verification Cadence INCREMENTAL, Current Increment 1; DEV-001 (search endpoint, AC-001, no dependencies) and DEV-002 (search UI, AC-002, depends on DEV-001) both PENDING; Increment 1 = DEV-001/AC-001, Increment 2 = DEV-002/AC-002; STATE records the plan path, BlockedOn NONE, no recovery, PendingVerificationCadence NONE. The plan being IN_PROGRESS with no started step follows the case text.

decision.note: Owner decision (2026-10-03, option 1): assertion 3's 'cycle and checkout identified' is satisfied by the protocol's standard handoff to STATE.md; grader-only fact added; re-judge 49.3.
